title: Burnout Legends
description: Criterion's handheld Burnout — the PSP title whose oracle cold-boots into the menus and races at 121 MPH. All 34 tracks are rebuilt from their static and streamed data: the drivable world assembled from the streaming cells (whose offsets are relative — the tell that the engine streams), the static environment as a toggleable layer, and each track opening on the road at its first streaming cell, looking down the racing line. Every vehicle ships at its highest detail level, drawn opaque exactly as the GE renders it.
